events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "set -euo pipefail
# Top 1000 genome-wide peaks by narrowPeak qValue (column 9), then retain chr1 intervals.
gzip -cd data/ENCFF717TCQ.bed.gz \\
  | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k9,9gr \\
  | head -1000 \\
  | awk -v OFS='\\t' '"'$1=="chr1" {print $1,$2,$3}'"' \\
  | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n -k3,3n > work/top1000_peaks.chr1.bed

# UCSC snp151Common: chr1, observed exactly B1/B2 where B1,B2 are distinct A/C/G/T.
gzip -cd data/snp151Common.txt.gz \\
  | awk -v OFS='\\t' '"'$2=="chr1" && $10 ~ /''^[ACGT]'"\\/ [ACGT]"'$/ {print}'"' > /dev/null"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc '# Top 1000 genome-wide peaks by qValue, chr1 subset
(gzip -cd data/ENCFF717TCQ.bed.gz | sort -t $'"'\\t' -k9,9gr | head -1000 || true) \\
  | awk -v OFS='\\t' '"'$1=="chr1" {print $1,$2,$3}'"' \\
  | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n -k3,3n > work/top1000_peaks.chr1.bed

# chr1 common SNPs with exactly two distinct observed A/C/G/T alleles.
gzip -cd data/snp151Common.txt.gz \\
  | awk -v OFS='\\t' '"'$2=="chr1" && $10 ~ /''^[ACGT]'"\\/[ACGT]"'$/ {split($10,a,"/"); if (a[1] != a[2]) print $2,$3,$3+1,$5,$10}'"' \\
  | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n -k3,3n > work/snp151Common.chr1.biallelic_acgt.bed

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
peaks=[]
with open('work/top1000_peaks.chr1.bed') as f:
    for line in f:
        c,s,e=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')[:3]
        peaks.append((int(s),int(e)))
peaks.sort()
# merge peaks for simpler containment/overlap
merged=[]
for s,e in peaks:
    if not merged or s>merged[-1][1]:
        merged.append([s,e])
    elif e>merged[-1][1]:
        merged[-1][1]=e
out=[]
i=0
with open('work/snp151Common.chr1.biallelic_acgt.bed') as f:
    for line in f:
        c,s,e,name,obs=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')[:5]
        s=int(s); e=int(e)
        while i < len(merged) and merged[i][1] <= s:
            i += 1
        if i < len(merged) and merged[i][0] < e and s < merged[i][1]:
            out.append((c,s,e,name,obs))
# unique by coordinate; if UCSC has duplicate rs at same base, keep coordinate once.
seen=set()
with open('work/target_snps.bed','w') as bed, open('work/target_snps.regions','w') as reg:
    for c,s,e,name,obs in out:
        key=(c,s,e)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        bed.write(f'{c}\\t{s}\\t{e}\\n')
        reg.write(f'{c}:{s+1}-{s+1}\\n')
print('chr1_top1000_peaks', len(peaks), 'merged', len(merged))
print('chr1_biallelic_common_snps', sum(1 for _ in open('work/snp151Common.chr1.biallelic_acgt.bed')))
print('target_snps', len(seen))
PY
wc -l work/top1000_peaks.chr1.bed work/snp151Common.chr1.biallelic_acgt.bed work/target_snps.bed
head -5 work/target_snps.regions; tail -5 work/target_snps.regions"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > scripts/format_query_to_tsv.py <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
samples = [line.rstrip('\\n') for line in open('work/samples.lex.txt')]
out_path = Path('out/genotypes.tsv')
valid_base = {'A','C','G','T'}
with out_path.open('w') as out:
    out.write('\\t'.join(['CHROM','POS','REF','ALT'] + samples) + '\\n')
    last_pos = -1
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.rstrip('\\n')
        if not line:
            continue
        fields = line.split('\\t')
        chrom, pos_s, ref, alt = fields[:4]
        pos = int(pos_s)
        if chrom "'!= '"'chr1':
            continue
        if len(ref) "'!= 1 or ref not in valid_base or len(alt) != 1 or alt not in valid_base:
            continue
        gts = []
        for gt in fields[4:]:
            gt = gt.split('"':', 1)[0].replace('|', '/')
            if gt in ('0/0', '1/1'):
                gts.append(gt)
            elif gt in ('0/1', '1/0'):
                gts.append('0/1')
            else:
                gts.append('./.')
        if len(gts) "'!= len(samples):
            raise SystemExit(f'"'expected {len(samples)} genotypes, found {len(gts)} at {chrom}:{pos}')
        out.write('\\t'.join([chrom, pos_s, ref, alt] + gts) + '\\n')
PY

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from collections import defaultdict
# Max q per unique interval, top 1000 unique intervals genome-wide.
best={}
with __import__('gzip').open('data/ENCFF717TCQ.bed.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if not line.strip() or line.startswith(('#','track','browser')): continue
        fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        key=tuple(fields[:3])
        q=float(fields[8])
        if key not in best or q>best[key]: best[key]=q
rows=sorted(best.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)[:1000]
chr1=[(int(k[1]),int(k[2]),q) for k,q in rows if k[0]=='chr1']
print('unique_total',len(best),'top1000_unique_chr1',len(chr1))
# intersect with len1 SNPs
peaks=sorted((s,e) for s,e,q in chr1)
merged=[]
for s,e in peaks:
    if not merged or s>merged[-1][1]: merged.append([s,e])
    elif e>merged[-1][1]: merged[-1][1]=e
seen=set(); i=0
for line in open('work/snp151Common.chr1.biallelic_acgt.len1.bed'):
    c,s,e,*_=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    s=int(s); e=int(e)
    while i<len(merged) and merged[i][1]<=s: i+=1
    if i<len(merged) and merged[i][0]<e and s<merged[i][1]: seen.add((c,s,e))
print('unique_alt_targets',len(seen),'merged_peaks',len(merged))
PY"
